_: All timing lives here, read by Blender (shots) and Node (captions). Times are song seconds. Video time v = song - start, frames are 1-based with v = (f-1)/30. To fix a late or early word, change its number and run: npm run lego:proof. Word times: forced aligner and Whisper on the Demucs vocal stem, snapped to the attack within 80 ms (src/lego/sync/attacks.py). The 'notes' list every word placed by judgement rather than by the snap rule.
_bleeps: The user chose caption-only censoring on 2026-11-05: retardado is sung as recorded. A span like [248.13, 249.03] here would bleep it again (run src/lego/sync/bleep.py).
